name: @wlahsib/mcp-onepiece

tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Full-text search of One Piece Wiki articles. Large articles are split into subpages (e.g. 'Monkey D. Luffy/Abilities and Powers'), and those show up in results too.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. 'Gomu Gomu no Mi' or 'Wano Country'

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Readable text of an article, with references, navigation boxes and the infobox removed (use get_infobox for that). For long articles pass `section` to fetch one part. When a spoiler limit is set, articles about subjects that debut past it are withheld and sections about later arcs are removed.

title.description: Article title, e.g. 'Roronoa Zoro'. Redirects such as 'Zoro' are followed.

section.description: Heading text (e.g. 'Personality') or index from get_page_sections. '0' is the intro.

tools.name: get_page_sections
tools.description: Section headings of an article, with indexes usable as get_page's `section`.

title.description: Article title, e.g. 'Roronoa Zoro'. Redirects such as 'Zoro' are followed.

tools.name: list_subpages
tools.description: Subpages of an article. Major characters are split into tabs such as '/History', '/Personality and Relationships', '/Abilities and Powers' and '/Misc.'; find them here, then read one with get_page.

title.description: Article title, e.g. 'Roronoa Zoro'. Redirects such as 'Zoro' are followed.

tools.name: get_infobox
tools.description: The article's infobox as label → value pairs. For characters: affiliations, occupations, bounty, Devil Fruit, age, birthday, height, debut chapter/episode and voice actors. Devil Fruits, arcs, ships and places have their own fields. Fields outside the main block are prefixed with their group, e.g. 'Devil Fruit – Type'. Withheld when a spoiler limit is set and the subject debuts past it.

title.description: Article title, e.g. 'Roronoa Zoro'. Redirects such as 'Zoro' are followed.

tools.name: get_page_categories
tools.description: Categories an article belongs to: a quick way to see a character's crews, Devil Fruit type, species, Haki and more.

title.description: Article title, e.g. 'Roronoa Zoro'. Redirects such as 'Zoro' are followed.

tools.name: get_category_members
tools.description: Articles and subcategories in a category, e.g. 'Straw Hat Pirates Members', 'Logia Devil Fruit Users', 'Male Characters'.

category.description: Category name, with or without the 'Category:' prefix

cursor.description: `next` from a previous call, to fetch the following page

tools.name: get_chapter
tools.description: A manga chapter's title, volume, release date, Weekly Shōnen Jump issue, the anime episodes that adapt it, its story arc and a short summary. Blocked when past the spoiler limit.

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: An anime episode's title, air date, season, opening song, the manga chapters it adapts (empty for filler) and a short summary. Blocked when it adapts chapters past the spoiler limit.

tools.name: get_arc
tools.description: A canon story arc's saga, position in the story, chapter/episode/volume ranges, release years and neighbouring arcs. Accepts loose names such as 'wano' or 'Enies Lobby'.

name.description: Arc name, e.g. 'Marineford' or 'Whole Cake Island Arc'

tools.name: list_arcs
tools.description: Every canon story arc in order, grouped by saga, with chapter and episode ranges. Also answers 'which arc is chapter N in?' via `chapter`. Arcs past the spoiler limit are left out.

chapter.description: Only return the arc containing this chapter

tools.name: list_filler_arcs
tools.description: Every anime-only (filler) story arc with its episode range and the canon arc it airs after or during. Answers 'which episodes can I skip?'. Standalone filler episodes inside canon arcs aren't listed; get_episode flags those (filler: true). Arcs airing alongside canon arcs past the spoiler limit are left out.

tools.name: list_cover_stories
tools.description: The manga's cover-page serials (short stories told across chapter title pages, e.g. Buggy's Crew Adventure Chronicles), in order with their saga, chapter range and, for the few the anime adapted, episode range. Serials starting past the spoiler limit are left out.

tools.name: set_spoiler_limit
tools.description: Set the last manga chapter the user has read. Afterwards, chapters, episodes and arcs past it are withheld, so are articles about characters, places and other subjects that debut past it, and article sections about later arcs are removed. Call with no chapter to turn the limit off. The limit (or its removal) is remembered for future sessions unless saving is turned off. Use this whenever the user says how far they are, e.g. 'I'm at chapter 900' or 'I just finished Enies Lobby'.

chapter.description: Last chapter read; omit to remove the limit

arc.description: Alternatively, the last arc finished, e.g. 'Enies Lobby'. The limit becomes that arc's final chapter.

tools.name: get_spoiler_limit
tools.description: The current spoiler limit (last chapter the user has read), or null if none is set, and where it came from: 'saved' (remembered from set_spoiler_limit), 'environment' (ONEPIECE_SPOILER_CHAPTER) or 'session' (set this session, not saved).

instructions:
Tools for the One Piece Wiki (onepiece.fandom.com), a fan wiki covering the One Piece manga and anime.
- Find exact titles with search_wiki; big characters are split into subpages (list_subpages).
- For facts like bounty, Devil Fruit, affiliations or debut, prefer get_infobox over reading the whole article.
- Use get_chapter / get_episode / get_arc / list_arcs for story structure; list_filler_arcs for anime-only arcs (which episodes can be skipped) and list_cover_stories for the manga's cover-page serials.
- If the user mentions how far they have read or watched, call set_spoiler_limit first and respect its notices. The limit is remembered across sessions.
- Wiki content is CC BY-SA; link the article URL when quoting it.
